warnings: Trip Tip (Morning Routine): Alice prefers early starts (6:00 AM–8:00 AM) while Bob prefers late mornings (10:00 AM–12:00 PM). Activities have been planned to commence around 9:00 AM daily, allowing Bob restful mornings and Alice peaceful early morning solo walks or quiet hotel breakfasts before group departures.

Trip Tip (Budget Tier): Alice prefers mid-range (Tier 2) and Bob prefers higher-range (Tier 3). Accommodations and dining have been balanced in the upper-mid tier (averaging ¥14,000–¥16,000/night for stylish, high-comfort central hotels) to provide superior convenience and quality without excessive expense.
